title: RHom base change for a perfect complex
statement: Let A\to A' be a morphism of commutative rings, let E be a perfect complex of A-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let K be any complex of A-modules [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module]. The canonical map A'\otimes_A^L RHom_A(E,K)\to RHom_{A'}(A'\otimes_A^L E,A'\otimes_A^L K) is an isomorphism [def-pc-derived-pullback].
